new_value: Fixed: Changed edhoc_kdf() info structure from (length, TH, label, context) to RFC 9528 compliant (label, context, length). Removed separate TH parameter - callers now pass TH as context. Eliminated edhoc_kdf_int() and unified on integer labels per RFC 9528 Figure 6. Updated all call sites in edhoc_initiator.c and edhoc_responder.c.
